info.title: ArgueBot API
info.description: Shared conversation service under implementation. Local pairing is loopback/origin restricted. All private operations require an active revocable bearer session. Credentials never appear in URLs.

tenantId.description: Resolved tenant, or null for unauthenticated/system events.

userId.description: Validated actor, never an untrusted request hint.

outcome.description: Semantic result without credentials or request content.

sessionId.description: Session identifier where known; never the token.

errorCode.description: Safe failure code, empty on success.

encrypted.description: Whether the archive is passphrase encrypted.

includesSecrets.description: Whether explicitly requested key material is included.

errorCode.description: Safe failure code, without exception details or credentials.

targetHome.description: Explicit new-home restore destination, otherwise empty.

targetConnectionEnvironmentVariable.description: Nonsecret PostgreSQL destination environment reference, otherwise empty.

retainedStagingHome.description: Protected staging home retained after an externally committed database could not be reconciled or published. Requires explicit operator recovery.

port.description: Requested listener port, or the effective port after successful restoration. Zero initially preserves the archive setting.

items.description: Matching items in stable newest-first order.

totalCount.description: Matching total independent of page size.

items.description: Matching items in stable newest-first order.

totalCount.description: Matching total independent of page size.

name.description: Display name for a newly created artifact, up to 200 characters.

includeSecrets.description: Include local encryption keys and literal database configuration. Requires a passphrase.

password.description: Optional encryption passphrase. A nonempty value requires at least twelve characters and at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; never persisted in job metadata.

destinationName.description: Required for restore. New child directory beneath the service home restores directory.

restoreDatabaseType.description: Destination provider for a new recovered home. SQLite is the default; PostgreSQL requires an empty pre-provisioned database.

restoreConnectionEnvironmentVariable.description: Environment reference on the service machine containing the PostgreSQL destination connection string. Never send its secret value.

port.description: Listener port for a new recovered home. Zero preserves the archived setting.

BackupRequest.description: Create accepts name/includeSecrets/password. Verify accepts password. Restore accepts password/destinationName/port/restoreDatabaseType/restoreConnectionEnvironmentVariable. Secret-inclusive creation requires encryption. Port zero retains the archived listener value; otherwise use 1024 through 65535. SQLite creates a new database file; PostgreSQL requires an empty pre-provisioned destination configured through a service-machine environment reference.

response.description: Whether this is a response header.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique command key, 1 to 200 characters for durable controls and messages; hold/release are transient.

lastEventSequence.description: Latest committed event sequence observed before this conversation read. Capture it before loading snapshots, then replay after it to cover concurrent changes.

mode.description: Run purpose: debate or followup. Follow-up uses exactly one participant.

question.description: Follow-up question, persisted as a message with this run.

CreateRunRequest.description: Debate requires two or three distinct participant IDs. Followup requires one participant and a nonempty question, and forces one round with no countdown.

question.description: Original conversation title frozen when this run was created. Renaming the conversation never changes historical prompts. Pre-schema-9 runs use the title available at migration.

mode.description: Run purpose derived from its immutable participant count.

text.description: Optional text delta or safe detail.

textOffset.description: UTF-16 code-unit offset for this committed text fragment within its message. Legacy events before schema 6 use zero and require snapshot reconciliation.

messageId.description: Answer message, preserved even if generation is interrupted.

number.description: Monotonic attempt number within this run.

state.description: Pending, streaming, completed, interrupted or failed. Acceptance precedes external invocation; interruption never proves the external operation did not run.

errorCode.description: Safe failure code without upstream response content.

promptVersion.description: Version of the deterministic system prompt template.

promptDigest.description: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 system prompt.

contextCharacters.description: Exact UTF-16 character count of system prompt plus selected message content; this is not a token estimate.

durationMilliseconds.description: Monotonic elapsed generation and durable stream flush time, zero if unavailable after a crash.

contextMessageIds.description: Exact ordered source messages selected for this attempt, including any one-recipient directives.

homeId.description: Opaque path-bound application-home routing identifier. Not an authentication credential.

homeProof.description: HMAC-SHA256 process proof bound to an optional random challenge, listener port and home. Empty when no challenge was requested.

schema.description: Current database schema version, independent of product version.

protocol.description: HTTP attachment protocol version, separate from schema and product versions.

passwordSha256.description: Sensitive SHA-256 password-equivalent input over HTTPS. The server derives a salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 storage verifier; neither value is returned.

contentBytes.description: Full stored UTF-8 content size. Bounded pages can return a shorter content preview with ContentTruncated true.

contentTruncated.description: Whether this transport result is a bounded preview. Fetch the individual message before treating its text as complete or exporting it.

throughSequence.description: Membership boundary captured for this page. Reuse it to traverse a stable set while new messages arrive; streaming content itself can still advance.

latestSequence.description: Latest stored sequence at request start, including messages beyond a supplied membership boundary.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant or null for protected global definitions.

resourceTypes.description: Resource types or All wildcard, bounded to 32 entries.

effect.description: Permit or Deny; explicit matching deny wins.

requiresOwnership.description: Narrow grants to actual resource ownership.

active.description: Whether the permission can contribute authority.

protected.description: Global seeded permissions cannot be edited through normal administration.

resourceTypes.description: Resource types or All wildcard, bounded to 32 entries.

effect.description: Permit or Deny; explicit matching deny wins.

requiresOwnership.description: Narrow grants to actual resource ownership.

active.description: Whether the permission can contribute authority.

expectedRevision.description: Current revision required for an update.

PermissionRequest.description: Tenant custom permit/deny definition. All is an explicit wildcard; Write expands to Create/Update/Delete and grants neither Execute nor Admin. Updates require expectedRevision; protected global definitions are immutable. Disable to preserve historical references.

startedTimestamp.description: Monotonic timestamp captured before route execution.

sessionId.description: Resolved revocable session identifier; empty for non-session internal calls.

authScheme.description: Validated transport carrier: BearerToken or XToken for enrolled HTTP sessions.

tenantId.description: Resolved tenant, or null for anonymous system traffic.

responseBytes.description: Original response size where known; minus one means streamed or unknown.

rawRequestBody.description: Redacted diagnostic request prefix; explicitly unmanaged content.

rawResponseBody.description: Redacted diagnostic response prefix; explicitly unmanaged content.

requestTruncated.description: Whether request capture is a prefix.

responseTruncated.description: Whether response capture is a prefix.

restarting.description: The host is draining and reloading configuration.

items.description: Ordered role metadata, including visible built-ins.
Bounded ordered mappings and current permission definitions.

roleRevision.description: Role revision observed with this mapping page.

permission.description: Current referenced permission metadata; inactive permissions confer no grant.

permissionIds.description: Complete desired active mapping set, maximum 128 distinct visible permission IDs.

expectedRevision.description: Current role revision required for replacement.

RolePermissionsRequest.description: Complete desired active permission mapping set for a tenant custom role. Replacement requires current role revision, refuses foreign IDs and protected changes, deactivates omitted mappings and reuses historical mapping IDs. Permission activity remains independent of mapping activity.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant, or null for globally visible built-ins.

builtin.description: Definition is supplied by the platform.

protected.description: Normal administration cannot mutate this definition.

active.description: Whether assignments can use this definition.

RoleRecord.description: Global protected built-ins have null tenantId; all created roles are current-tenant custom definitions. Deactivate instead of deleting to preserve historical assignments.

name.description: Display name for a tenant custom role.

active.description: Whether the custom role can contribute authority.

cloneRoleId.description: Optional accessible role to copy when creating a custom role; omit for updates.

RoleRequest.description: Create optionally clones active permission mappings from an accessible role. Updates replace name/active and require expectedRevision; cloneRoleId is create-only. Built-in names are reserved and built-in definitions are immutable. Current database tenant/system administrator flags are required until full scoped administration integration.

arguments.description: Ordered arguments; prompts use standard input.

secretEnvironmentVariable.description: Environment reference to credential; never its value.

enabled.description: Whether new work can use this profile.

RunnerProfile.description: CLI requires executable and uses ordered arguments plus stdin. REST requires endpoint and model. secretEnvironmentVariable is a reference, never the secret itself. Profiles are frozen into relational snapshots for each run.

token.description: Opaque revocable one-hour session. Keep it out of logs, URLs and source control.

totalCount.description: Count matching the tenant and search filter.

email.description: Normalized email, unique within the tenant when configured.

role.description: Compatibility domain role: viewer, operator or admin.

protected.description: Whether normal management must refuse mutation.

hasPassword.description: Whether password login has been configured.

UserRecord.description: Public tenant identity metadata. No password verifier or hash is returned. Protected identities cannot be changed through normal management. Administrator flags are separate from compatibility domain role names.

name.description: Display name, one through two hundred characters.

role.description: Compatibility domain role: viewer, operator or admin.

isAdmin.description: System administrator flag, assignable only by a system administrator.

active.description: Enable authentication; disabling invalidates existing sessions.

expectedRevision.description: Expected revision for updates; zero for creation.

passwordSha256.description: Sensitive SHA-256 password-equivalent input over HTTPS. The server derives a salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 storage verifier; neither value is returned.

UserRequest.description: Complete metadata replacement. Omit passwordSha256 to preserve its password; a new value revokes existing sessions. Disablement also revokes sessions atomically. Updates require expectedRevision. Only system administrators may manage system administrators; all management remains bound to the current tenant.

telemetry.description: Process telemetry collection and export settings.

requestHistoryEnabled.description: Capture HTTP request history by default.

requestHistoryBodyBytes.description: Capture prefix limit in bytes, default 32768.

requestHistoryRetentionDays.description: Request history retention in days, default thirty.

database.description: Persistent database configuration. SQLite is the local default.

tlsEnabled.description: Enable HTTPS using keys/listener.pfx in the application home. Password login requires HTTPS.

tlsPasswordEnvironmentVariable.description: Optional environment variable containing the listener PFX password. No literal password is persisted.

port.description: Loopback service port, default 4317, allowed 1 through 65535.

streamBatchCharacters.description: Maximum accumulated stream characters before a durable commit. Default 4096, allowed one through 65536.

streamCommitMilliseconds.description: Maximum stream timer interval in milliseconds, even when the runner stops emitting. Default 250, allowed ten through 5000.

eventRetentionEnabled.description: Enable background pruning of replay-event prefixes. Transcript and audit history are retained independently. Default true.

eventRetentionDays.description: Replay age target in days, default thirty, range one through 3650. The latest event is always retained to preserve monotonic sequencing.

eventMaxPerConversation.description: Maximum retained replay events per conversation, default 10000, range one through 1000000.

eventMaintenanceSeconds.description: Background retention interval in seconds, default sixty, range five through 3600.

eventRetentionBatchSize.description: Conversation metadata batch bound for retention, default one hundred, range one through one thousand.

eventReplayPageSize.description: Default events per replay read, default one thousand, range one through one thousand.

historyPreviewCodePoints.description: Maximum Unicode code points in each message preview returned by paged history. Default 4096, range 128 through 16384. Full message reads remain explicit.

contextMaxCharacters.description: Maximum exact UTF-16 characters in the system prompt plus selected message content. Default 262144, range 1024 through 16777216. Oversized context pauses without invoking a model or truncating history.

contextMaxMessages.description: Maximum selected messages per generation attempt. Default 1000, range one through 10000.

allowCli.description: Whether shell-out runners may execute. Default true for local mode only.

enabled.description: Enable the collector subscription, default true.

exportEnabled.description: Enable outbound OTLP to the local observability collector, default false outside Compose.

endpoint.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint, default 127.0.0.1:4327 to avoid the application port.

connectionString.description: SQLite path or server connection string without committed secrets.

connectionEnvironmentVariable.description: Optional environment variable that overrides ConnectionString.

code.description: Current single-use code read locally by the owner.

tlsEnabled.description: Optional HTTPS toggle. Provision keys/listener.pfx before enabling; restart to apply.

tlsPasswordEnvironmentVariable.description: Optional listener PFX password environment reference; omission preserves it.

port.description: Configured port, from 1 to 65535. Explicit launch flags still win.

streamBatchCharacters.description: Optional stream batch threshold, one through 65536 characters. Omission preserves the configured value.

streamCommitMilliseconds.description: Optional stream flush interval, ten through 5000 milliseconds. Omission preserves the configured value.

eventRetentionEnabled.description: Optional background replay retention toggle. Omission preserves its configured value.

eventRetentionDays.description: Optional replay age target, one through 3650 days.

eventMaxPerConversation.description: Optional retained event bound per conversation, one through 1000000.

eventMaintenanceSeconds.description: Optional retention interval, five through 3600 seconds.

eventRetentionBatchSize.description: Optional maintenance metadata batch size, one through one thousand.

eventReplayPageSize.description: Optional default replay size, one through one thousand.

historyPreviewCodePoints.description: Optional Unicode code-point limit per message preview, 128 through 16384. Omission preserves its configured value.

contextMaxCharacters.description: Optional context character budget, 1024 through 16777216. Omission preserves its configured value.

contextMaxMessages.description: Optional selected context message bound, one through 10000. Omission preserves its configured value.

allowCli.description: Allow local shell-out execution after restart.

connectionEnvironmentVariable.description: Server environment reference for the connection string.

settings.description: Editable nonsecret settings. Connection strings are never returned.

revision.description: Digest of the current settings file for optimistic writes.

restartRequired.description: Whether this file differs from the running configuration.

portOverridden.description: Whether the running port is overridden by an explicit command-line flag.

connectionConfigured.description: Whether a private database connection string is configured.
